title: Manila wrote Asean’s AI terms before the vendors arrived
description: FERDINAND Marcos Jr. handed the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) its first legally binding digital rule book three days before Donald Trump landed in Manila. The Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA), signed by the bloc’s ministers on Nov. 14, sets common terms for data flows, electronic payments, data protection and cooperation on artificial intelligence (AI) across 11 economies. When Trump reached Malacañang, the sequence held. Asked about the Pax Silica framework deal, Marcos kept it short: “There is no signing. No, not on this trip.”
